summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, added a CHANGELOG entry, and updated tests/test_progress.py. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a documented class docstring, and a static render_speed; track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it through; Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total. Added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the two ValueError assertions. Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black were not executed, per instructions. Speed strings were verified by hand only. Nothing was committed.
